import sympy as sp
x = sp.Symbol('x', real=True)
g = sp.Symbol('g', positive=True)
Z0 = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-x**2 / 2), (x, -sp.oo, sp.oo))
assert sp.simplify(Z0 - sp.sqrt(2 * sp.pi)) == 0
m4 = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(x**4 * sp.exp(-x**2 / 2), (x, -sp.oo, sp.oo)) / Z0)
m8 = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(x**8 * sp.exp(-x**2 / 2), (x, -sp.oo, sp.oo)) / Z0)
m12 = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(x**12 * sp.exp(-x**2 / 2), (x, -sp.oo, sp.oo)) / Z0)
assert (m4, m8, m12) == (3, 105, 10395)
Z_ratio = 1 - g * m4 + g**2 * m8 / 2
assert sp.simplify(Z_ratio - (1 - 3*g + sp.Rational(105, 2)*g**2)) == 0
F_ser = sp.series(-sp.log(Z_ratio), g, 0, 3).removeO()
assert sp.simplify(F_ser - (3*g - 48*g**2)) == 0
print('Z_ratio =', Z_ratio, '| F_ser =', F_ser, '| rem_bound_coeff =', sp.Rational(m12, 6))

input.text: Exact Gaussian moments give Z(0) = sqrt(2*pi), <x^4>_0 = 3, <x^8>_0 = 105, <x^12>_0 = 10395. Since |exp(-u) - (1 - u + u^2/2)| <= u^3/6 for u = g*x^4 >= 0, Z(g)/Z(0) = 1 - 3*g + (105/2)*g^2 + O(g^3) with remainder bounded by (3465/2)*g^3 as g -> 0+. Taking -ln gives F(g) = 3*g - 48*g^2 + O(g^3).
